en: Stop. Don't shoot. I can help you.
zh: 住手，别开枪，我能帮你。

en: You're Gryphon, right?
zh: 你是格里芬，对吧？

en: Deputy Administrator Gryphon? Yes.
zh: 副行政主管格里芬？是我。

en: Why do I need your help? I'm the one with the gun.
zh: 我为什么需要你帮忙？枪在我手上。

en: I have vital information. You must take me to Eos.
zh: 我有关键情报，你必须带我去见伊欧丝。

en: What do you know about Eos?
zh: 你知道伊欧丝什么？

en: Ultor knows all about her. They set this whole thing up.
zh: 乌尔托对她了如指掌，这整件事就是他们设的局。

en: You must take me to her.
zh: 你必须带我去见她。

en: What do you mean they set this whole thing up?
zh: 你说这是他们设的局，什么意思？

en: No time to explain. Take me to Eos.
zh: 没时间解释了，带我去见伊欧丝。

en: I'll tell her everything I know.
zh: 我知道的都会告诉她。

en: Explain it to me first.
zh: 先跟我说清楚。

en: I'll tell you what I can on the way, but more guards are going to show up soon.
zh: 我尽量在路上跟你说，很快会有更多警卫过来的。
note: 识别为 in a way，按语境应为 on the way

en: I'm right behind you. Betray me or try to run, and you'll be the first to die.
zh: 我就在你后面。敢出卖我或者想跑，你第一个死。

en: Put that gun away. If the guards see you with it, we're both dead.
zh: 把枪收起来。让警卫看见的话，我们俩都得死。

en: Yeah, yeah, Parker, great job. You can pose for pictures later. We gotta keep moving.
zh: 行了行了，帕克，干得漂亮。照相以后再说，我们得赶路。

en: Shut up, Weasel! If Eos didn't want you, you'd be dead by now. I'll decide when it's time to go.
zh: 闭嘴，黄鼠狼！要不是伊欧丝要你，你早没命了。什么时候走我说了算。

en: Okay, let's go.
zh: 好吧，走。

en: Hoof it! I'm not carrying your sorry butt anymore.
zh: 快走！别指望我再拖着你。

en: Parker! Gryphon! Over here! We're here to take Gryphon to Eos.
zh: 帕克！格里芬！这边！我们来接格里芬去见伊欧丝。

en: Thank God.
zh: 谢天谢地。

en: Well, whatever. Let's get moving before security shows up.
zh: 随便吧。趁警卫还没来，赶紧走。

en: And not you, Parker. Just the weasel here. Eos will contact you.
zh: 你不去，帕克，只带这只黄鼠狼。伊欧丝会联系你。

en: Well, thanks Parker, and good luck. And hey, don't you start calling me Weasel too.
zh: 那，谢了帕克，祝你好运。还有，你可别也跟着叫我黄鼠狼。

en: Great. Screwed again.
zh: 好极了，又被涮了。

en: Parker, how nice to see you. I must thank you for starting this little diversion. It has made my work so much easier.
zh: 帕克，见到你真好。我该谢谢你搞出这场小骚乱，它让我的工作轻松了不少。

en: What's that mean, you half-human freak?
zh: 什么意思，你这个半人不人的怪物？

en: These troubles have given me the perfect excuse to accelerate my experiments. Who will notice a few more vanished miners in all this confusion?
zh: 这些乱子给了我加速实验的绝佳借口。这么混乱，谁还会注意到又少了几个矿工？

en: To hell with orders! Die, Capek!
zh: 去他的命令！去死吧，卡佩克！

en: Congratulations, Parker. You were the first to see my nanotech shield in action.
zh: 恭喜你，帕克，你是头一个见识我纳米护盾的人。

en: Now I must return to my work. Enjoy what little time you have left, you and your friends.
zh: 我得回去工作了，你和你的朋友们就好好享受你们剩下的那点时间吧。

en: Parker, stop! Don't kill him!
zh: 帕克，住手！别杀他！

en: Don't kill him? He's killed hundreds of miners.
zh: 别杀他？他害死了几百个矿工。

en: And hundreds more will die unless we find a cure for the plague.
zh: 要是找不到瘟疫的解药，还会再死几百个。

en: We can't save the miners who are dead already, but we might save those who are dying. He's their only hope.
zh: 死了的救不回来了，但还在病的也许能救，他是他们唯一的指望。

en: Hope? Who has hope?
zh: 指望？谁还有指望？

en: If you have hope, you just don't understand yet.
zh: 你要还有指望，只能说明你还没想明白。

en: My work... all gone.
zh: 我的心血……全没了。
note: 识别为 I'm gonna work all gone，语法不通；按语境判定，待确认

en: Capek, the plague, there's got to be a cure.
zh: 卡佩克，那场瘟疫，一定有解药。

en: Simple, really.
zh: 很简单。

en: Stop the replicators.
zh: 让复制体停下来。

en: But how? How do you stop them?
zh: 可是怎么停？要怎么让它们停下来？

en: Antidote, of course.
zh: 当然是靠解药。

en: Come on, Eos. Let's finish him and get out of here.
zh: 别问了，伊欧丝。做掉他，我们走。

en: We need that antidote, Parker. If you're not going to help, shut up.
zh: 我们需要那份解药，帕克，你不帮忙就闭嘴。

en: Where is the antidote?
zh: 解药在哪？

en: Why help you? Hope you all die.
zh: 我凭什么帮你们？我巴不得你们全死光。

en: Damn!
zh: 该死！

en: The formula's got to be in his computer files. Maybe Hendrix can help.
zh: 配方肯定在他的电脑文件里，也许亨德里克斯能帮上忙。

en: Parker, you've got to get out of here. One of us has to live through this.
zh: 帕克，你得离开这儿，我们总得活下来一个。

en: No! I'm not gonna leave!
zh: 不！我不走！

en: No time to argue. Go out the way I came in. If I don't make it, you must tell people there's a cure for the plague.
zh: 没时间争了，从我进来的路出去。我要是回不来，你一定要告诉大家瘟疫有解药。

en: Sure hope this works.
zh: 但愿这管用。

en: Come on, come on...
zh: 快啊，快啊……

en: Hold it right there!
zh: 站住别动！

en: Mom said I'd come to a bad end.
zh: 我妈说过我不得好死。

en: This one's for you, Mom.
zh: 这一下是为你，妈。

en: Manual launch override engaged.
zh: 手动发射超控已启动。

en: Thirty seconds until launch.
zh: 距发射三十秒。

en: Escape pod number two, detaching in five seconds.
zh: 二号逃生舱，五秒后脱离。

en: Four, three, two, one, detach.
zh: 四、三、二、一，脱离。
